services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: O'Keefe Ranch Education Programs are offered in May, June, September, and October, and we are currently accepting bookings for the 2026 school year. We also offer summer programs for day cares, day camps, and homeschool groups. The Historic O'Keefe Ranch is a unique site to educate and entertain all learning levels. The program offers immersive learning opportunities for elementary students, and annually attracts schools from throughout the valley. All groups can book 3 guided and 1 self-guided program to fill their day. Our program is tailored to each grade and has flexibility to include special requests. We are also able to offer field trip options for groups outside of regular school

services.name: Glamping at the Ranch
services.desc: O'Keefe Ranch offers a unique and immersive Glamping experience that takes you back in time while providing modern comforts. Here's what makes our Glamping site exceptional: Glamping at the Ranch is unique because it allows travellers to immerse themselves in the rich history of the area. Nestled on 50 acres of farmland, you'll find yourself surrounded by more than 15 heritage buildings, providing a glimpse into the past. Our Glamping site offers a variety of accommodations, including canvas tents of various sizes, suitable for 2 to 8 guests, and two cozy domes that sleep 2.
